dashboard.title: Signal Explorer
dashboard.description: Explore any raw signal from InfluxDB. Select log file → device type → device ID → signal.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "robot-telemetry")
  |> range(start: time(v: "${file_start}"), stop: time(v: "${file_end}"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "robot_telemetry")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device_type == "${device_type}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => (r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id) =~ /^(${device_id:regex})$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.signal =~ /^(${signal:regex})$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.file == "${file}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 200ms, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: (if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "TalonFX-1" then "FL Drive" else if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "TalonFX-3" then "FL Steer" else if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "CANcoder-3" then "FL Encoder" else if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "TalonFX-40" then "FR Drive" else if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "TalonFX-28" then "FR Steer" else if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "CANcoder-2" then "FR Encoder" else if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "TalonFX-18" then "BL Drive" else if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "TalonFX-16" then "BL Steer" else if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "CANcoder-16" then "BL Encoder" else if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "TalonFX-19" then "BR Drive" else if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "TalonFX-17" then "BR Steer" else if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "CANcoder-17" then "BR Encoder" else if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "TalonFX-48" then "Intake Arm" else if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "CANcoder-24" then "Intake Arm Enc" else if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "TalonFX-45" then "Intake Wheels" else if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "TalonFX-26" then "Indexer" else if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "TalonFX-55" then "Chamber" else if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "TalonFX-32" then "Turret" else if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "CANcoder-50" then "Turret Enc 1" else if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "CANcoder-51" then "Turret Enc 2" else if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "TalonFX-52" then "Hood" else if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "TalonFX-50" then "Flywheel 1" else if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "TalonFX-51" then "Flywheel 2" else if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "TalonFX-23" then "Climber Outer 1" else if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "TalonFX-6" then "Climber Outer 2" else if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "TalonFX-15" then "Climber Inner 1" else if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "TalonFX-56" then "Climber Inner 2" else if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "Pigeon2-0" then "Pigeon2 IMU" else r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id) + " - " + r.signal}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

list.name: file_start
list.label: File Start
list.query:
from(bucket: "robot-telemetry")
  |> range(start: 0)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "robot_telemetry" and r.file == "${file}" and r._field == "value")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time"])
  |> group()
  |> min(column: "_time")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: string(v: r._time)}))

list.name: file_end
list.label: File End
list.query:
import "experimental"
from(bucket: "robot-telemetry")
  |> range(start: 0)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "robot_telemetry" and r.file == "${file}" and r._field == "value")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time"])
  |> group()
  |> max(column: "_time")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: string(v: experimental.addDuration(d: 1s, to: r._time))}))

list.name: signal
list.label: Signal
list.query:
from(bucket: "robot-telemetry")
  |> range(start: 0)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "robot_telemetry")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device_type == "${device_type}")
  |> keep(columns: ["signal"])
  |> group()
  |> distinct(column: "signal")
